title: Choose the pitch page's structure
question: The world is settled (Ear Tag + Passbook). Pick how the landing page tells VEYRA's story, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: The traveling tag
options.thesis: One giant ear tag carries the pitch: its face holds the hook, and as you scroll it collects a stamp for every step VEYRA proves.
options.viewport: Black nav with Open the live demo. A tag-yellow ear tag fills the left half with the hook set on it; beside it the first stamp (MUZZLE MATCH · 92.5% correct on held-out animals) and the black/yellow demo button.
options.risk: If the tag is drawn as a picture the hook stops reading as text; it must stay real type on a real shape.

options.label: Four records, one passport
options.thesis: The problem made visible: identity, value, camera, and policy records scattered as slips, assembling into one passport with a stamp.
options.viewport: Headline across the top. Left: four tilted record slips (ear-tag register, valuation sheet, CCTV still, policy schedule) on a grey ground. Right: the assembled passport for animal-demo-001 with a stamped line. Demo button under the headline.
options.risk: Tilted slips can read as clutter; the passport side must clearly win the eye.

options.label: The passbook is the pitch
options.thesis: The page is one open passbook: the left page introduces VEYRA, the right page lists the journey as numbered lines, and the last line awaits your stamp: open the live demo.
options.viewport: One open book, two pages on one gutter. Left page: tag logo, hook, one-line pitch, audiences. Right page: lines 001 Enrolled to 005 Claim submitted, then line 006 awaiting: the stamp slot is the demo button.
options.risk: A book object can feel slow to scan for judges; every line must carry a real fact.
